output_text:
```python
import os
import base64
from google.cloud import vision_v1

def score_image_safety(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = vision_v1.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    image = vision_v1.Image(content=base64.b64decode(payload) if isinstance(payload, str) else payload)
    request = vision_v1.AnnotateImageRequest(
        image=image,
        features=[vision_v1.Feature(type_=vision_v1.Feature.Type.SAFE_SEARCH_DETECTION)]
    )
    result = client.batch_annotate_images(requests=[request]).responses[0].safe_search_annotation
    return {
        "adult": result.adult,
        "violence": result.violence,
        "racy": result.racy,
        "medical": result.medical,
        "spoof": result.spoof
    }
```
